easyPrerequisites: You control a permanent that has a time counter on it.
description:
Activate Jhoira's Timebug by tapping it, putting a time counter on a permanent you control that already has a time counter on it.
Kate's first ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Repeat.
